check_events.outcome: Verified conditionally on the preceding geometric identification: let R be Zhat or its prime-to-p counterpart, Q=R^J/R·1, q the quotient, and S a proper subset of J. If the complement has size 1 then q(R^S)=Q. If its size is at least 2, a coordinate generator e_j outside S cannot lie in R^S+R·1, because two outside coordinates force the common scalar to be both 1 and 0. Thus S is exactly the set of coordinate generators contained in its span. Equality for proper S,T forces S=T unless both complements have size 1. The geometric identification of Q was not proved in this check; no glyph decision follows from it.
